The federal court will likely grant the remand motion and send the entire case back to state court. Only a defendant may remove under 28 U.S.C. § 1441(a), so the plaintiff's improper removal is defective even though the complaint pleads federal claims. The attorney's wish to avoid the judge is irrelevant, and the court may also award the employer fees and costs under § 1447(c).

CONFIDENCE: 92
